export default function LoveScrollSite() { return (
{/* Opening Quote */}

To the One Who Saw Me

"This is a permanent letter. One that unfolds with every scroll."

{/* Chapter 1: What You Healed In Me */}

Chapter 1: What You Healed in Me

You softened my self-doubt until I believed in myself. You helped me become unshakable. You accepted every flaw — my doubts, my awkward body, my weird teeth, even my sweaty skin. Where I saw shame, you saw something worth loving.

{/* Chapter 2: Our Shared Weirdness */}

Chapter 2: We’re Both Silly

We’re both timid, unserious, soft around the edges. You’re silly and empathetic in a way that makes my heart feel safe. You laugh like I do. You even flip me off like a gremlin. I love that.

{/* Chapter 3: Your Perfect Imperfections */}

Chapter 3: Your Perfect Weirdness

You think you’re not normal. But it’s your imperfectness that makes you perfect. Beautiful, weird, flawed, feminine. That’s what a good human is.

{/* Chapter 4: I Want to Help You Heal */}

Chapter 4: When You’re in Pain

I hate being far when your legs ache, when you carry things and your shoulder hurts. I wish I could massage the pain away, carry the weight, fix your spine, and help you rise stronger.
“You are not a burden. Your pain doesn’t scare me.”

{/* Chapter 5: Your Body Is a Masterpiece */}

Chapter 5: Your Beauty

Your tiny fingers, your hair, your lips, your body — you are a pearl among glass shards. And your daily burdens? They make me want to teleport and help ease your life.
“You’re not just what the world sees. You’re what it could never guess.”

{/* Chapter 6: You Loved Me Without Trying */}

Chapter 6: You Made Me Feel Loved

You cared for my problems. You believed in me when I didn’t. Your voice cured my days, made me forget my struggles, even my addiction. You didn’t need to over-express anything — your presence alone made me feel whole.

{/* Chapter 7: What I Promise */}

Chapter 7: What I Want to Give You

I want to create a calm space where we can be weird, flawed, and brilliant together. A place where you’re safe. Loved. Pampered. I want to do my best, even if I fail sometimes.

{/* Closing */}

“If this website could talk, it would tell you everything I feel when I hear your name.”

More to come, always. Just scroll further next time.

); }
